why: Lane dispatched by manager session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP to diagnose 6 legs the R5 soak grader (PR #13029) flagged as mechanically-dead starved (0 orders): bybit_1/trend_donchian, bybit_1/trend_donchian_eth_4h, and 4 alpaca_paper legs (gld_pullback_1d, iaum_pullback_1d, tlt_pullback_1h, tqqq_trend_long_1d). Root-caused most of them to the same-account/same-symbol single-winner-per-tick election in src/runtime/intents.py (aggregate_intents / arbitration_fanout.plan_per_account_election) -- a strategy can be mechanically healthy, execution:live, correctly rostered, and STILL show 0 orders forever because a sibling on the same account/symbol always wins the tick's election (documented precedent: PI-20260926-BN2S6RQZ bybit_1 trend_donchian_sol_4h/ict_scalp_xrp_15m/ict_scalp_sol_15m, graded 'working as designed'). The R5 grader (scripts/ops/soak_book_grade.py) had no way to tell that shape apart from a genuinely dead leg, so it proposed killing 6 legs that are not mechanically dead. This PR is purely observational: scripts/ops/leg_flow_detector.py gains a pure, config-only live_symbol_contenders() helper (no I/O, no order-path or live-VM change); scripts/ops/leg_flow_report.py threads it onto each leg's report row (same contract as the existing has_open_position context field); scripts/ops/soak_book_grade.py's disposition_for_leg() now grades a starved leg with >=1 live same-account/same-symbol contender as insufficient-data (needing a live per-tick election trace) instead of kill, mirroring the existing has_open_position precedent exactly. All touched paths (scripts/ops/**, tests/**) are Tier-1 surface; no config/**, src/** order-path, or deploy/** file is touched. New + existing self-tests and pytest all green.
